path.description: Absolute path to the local input file.

start_slide.description: First slide to return, one-based. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Number to return, at most 10. Defaults to 10.

text_offset.description: Zero-based character offset returned by a previous call. Select exactly one item when resuming.

include_notes.description: Include the slide's speaker notes as a separate text result. Defaults to false.

notes_offset.description: Zero-based speaker-notes offset. Select exactly one slide and set include_notes to true.
